title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 144 (Auditor not to render certain services)

content.overview: An auditor appointed under this Act shall provide to the company only such other services as are approved by the Board of Directors or the audit committee, as the case may be, but which shall not include any of the following services, whether rendered directly or indirectly to the company or its holding company or subsidiary company, namely:— (i) accounting and book keeping services; (ii) internal audit; (iii) design and implementation of any financial information system; (iv) actuarial services; (v) investment advisory services; (vi) investment banking services; (vii) rendering of outsourced financial services; (viii) management services; and (ix) any other kind of services as may be prescribed.
content.glance: An auditor shall not render the listed prohibited services, directly or indirectly, to the company, its holding company or subsidiary; other services need Board or audit committee approval.

sections.heading: Prohibited list
sections.body: Nine categories including accounting, internal audit, financial information systems, actuarial, investment advisory/banking, outsourced financial and management services.

sections.heading: Approved other services
sections.body: Non-prohibited services only if approved by the Board or audit committee.

examples.title: Internal audit barred
examples.body: Statutory auditor cannot also provide internal audit to the company or its subsidiary. Educational illustration.

hypotheticals.question: Can the Board approve the auditor to provide book-keeping services?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Accounting and book-keeping are on the prohibited list; Board approval cannot override the statutory bar.

misconceptions.trap: Treating Board approval as sufficient for a prohibited service.
misconceptions.correction: The listed services are barred; approval cannot authorise them.

misconceptions.trap: Importing unrelated BSA or generic corporate cases into this topic.
misconceptions.correction: Keep the answer within sections 144 and 141.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What services may an auditor not render under section 144?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: The listed services (accounting, internal audit, financial information systems, actuarial, investment advisory/banking, outsourced financial, management, and any prescribed service), whether directly or indirectly, to the company, holding company or subsidiary.

examTips: State that approval cannot override the bar.
revisionPoints: Directly or indirectly; company, holding or subsidiary.
Other services need Board/audit committee approval.
